P6_kcl_review_P0.title: Changes requested by the kcl review plan (kcl/PLAN.md P0) — NOT a phase of this plan: kk._return printf, set -u contract across kklass+kkore+ktests, builder locals, hermetic .ckk tests, kkore numeric guards, ktests UTF-8 pin
P6_kcl_review_P0.source: kcl/PLAN.md P0 + kcl/kcl_ledger.json (findings G1-13, G2-03, G1-14, G8-01, G8-04; decisions D1, D6, D7, R15)
changes: kklass.sh kk._return: 'echo -n' -> printf '%s' (G1-13/G2-03). echo parses -e/-n/-E/-en/-neE/-nEe as its own options, so every func and every function-kind computed property silently returned '' for such a value under $( ), while the direct-call RESULT path was correct — which is why the whole corpus stayed green. Test tests/127_ReturnValueFidelity.sh: 24 assertions, 6 red before the fix.

set -u contract (G1-14 + G8-01, kcl decision D7 — a kcl unit must be sourceable from a script running 'set -eu'): default-guard every indirect metadata read (~36 sites in kklass.sh, kklass_pascal.sh, kklass_decl.sh, kklass_serializable.sh), the meth_index lookup in defineClass, the optional '=' positional in kk._prop_computed/kk._prop_plain, the optional parent positional in class(), and the re-source guards in kklass_pascal.sh/kklass_decl.sh/kklass_kkp.sh. Test tests/128_SetUContract.sh: 31 assertions.

Same set -u fix in kkore (klib, kerr, kvar, kcfg, kuse) and ktests (all five files, plus the KTESTS_LIB_DIR and KK_OUTPUT_COUNTS reads). kerr.sh's RE-SOURCE branch read a bare positional $1: that one bites in production, because kklass.sh loads kkore and tlist.sh / tdictionary.sh / tstopwatch.sh then source kerr.sh a second time, taking exactly that branch. Caught only after adding a 'source every file TWICE' case to 128.

Builder namespace (G8-04): local m p sm sp wm in kk._build_class_runtime, local wm in kk._processMethodBody, local m in _defineMethodType. Every defineClass used to clobber the caller's one-letter variables, and kcl units define their classes at source time. Test tests/129_BuilderNamespace.sh.

Tests 030/031/063/065 made hermetic (kcl R15): private fixture dir + KKLASS_CKK_DIR under the ktests temp dir, so no test writes .ckk into $PWD any more (a sweep started from a kcl unit directory used to leave a stray <unit>/.ckk; four were in the tree). REVISES the P5 note that a runner-wide KKLASS_CKK_DIR was rejected: the pin is PER TEST, not runner-wide, and 027/032/033 still exercise the default cwd/.ckk contract because they cd into kklass/tests first. Their weak asserts were rewritten too: 030 accepted 'Force OR Compiling' and 031 'runtime OR No compiled', both of which pass on the failure path as well.

kkore/klib.sh gained kk.isInt / kk.isNum / kk._setOut (kcl decision D1, shared numeric guards; locals carry the __kk_ prefix and that prefix is refused as an output-variable name, because bash scopes locals dynamically). ktests/ktest.sh pins LC_ALL=LANG=C.UTF-8 (kcl decision D6). Neither is used by kklass itself.
